text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain plans new services and housing projects; will extend loans to citizens to build or buy houses.
- New expanded 40-member Bahrain Shura council is to start first session on Tuesday.
- Bahrain's cabinet condemns Israeli repressive measures against Palestinians.
- Bahrain's gross domestic product rose four percent in 1995. Commercial banks' performance continues to improve.
- Jordanian and Saudi Arabian contacts to settle border dispute between Bahrain and Qatar.
- Bahrain planning major boost for industrial units.
